title: How to Create a TikTok Shop Account in 2025: Step-by-Step Seller Guide
summary: Learn how to create a TikTok Shop seller account, navigate Seller Center, and start selling in the US. Step-by-step guide with requirements, login tips, and app setup.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### Do I need 1,000 followers to have a TikTok Shop?


No, the 1,000-follower requirement applies to linking a TikTok account to certain commerce features, not to opening a TikTok Shop seller account. The seller registration process through TikTok Shop Seller Center is based on identity verification and seller eligibility, not follower count.


### Do you need an LLC to start a TikTok Shop?


You do not need an LLC to start a TikTok Shop. US applicants can register as either an individual seller or a business seller, depending on who will legally own and operate the shop. Business sellers will need business registration and tax information, while individual sellers typically need government-issued ID.


### How much does it cost to set up a TikTok Shop?


Creating a TikTok Shop seller account is free. You register through TikTok Shop Seller Center at no charge, submit verification documents, and configure your shop profile, payout, and shipping details. Your main costs come later, from inventory, fulfillment, and any applicable seller fees.


### Can I use my existing personal TikTok account to create a TikTok Shop?


Yes, you can use an existing TikTok account as a sign-up method during TikTok Shop registration. That linked profile connects your content to commerce, but it does not replace seller registration. You still need to complete identity verification and shop setup through Seller Center.


### How do I make a new user for TikTok Shop?


TikTok Shop Seller Center lets you add team members to manage your shop after your seller account is approved. Start by completing your own seller registration and verification, then use the account settings in Seller Center to invite new users with the access levels your operation needs.


### What documents do I need for the TikTok Shop create account process?


The TikTok Shop create account process requires government-issued ID for individual sellers or business registration and tax details for business sellers. Also prepare an accessible phone or email for verification codes, your legal name and address, and payout account plus shipping information before you apply.


### Why was my TikTok Shop seller application rejected or delayed?


Most TikTok Shop application delays come from mismatched details between your application, identification, and payout records. Enter names and addresses exactly as they appear on official documents, upload clear images with no glare or cropped edges, and confirm you meet the current US seller requirements in Seller Center.
